items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lionel Hampton was not in the studio with me. ... I didn’t know that.

ctx.x: Orlando DiGirolamo on accordion, Larry Coryell, Ryo Kawasaki, Lincoln Goines on electric bass, Cecil McBee, Buddy Williams, Carol Steele, and Alyrio Lima on percussion.
No idea. They were definitely not in the studio. Lionel Hampton was not in the studio with me.
Oh, I’m sure he wasn’t. You’d remember that.
